name: Decent Planet Game
desc:
🪐 DPG is a space exploration game with it being inspired by Untitled Planet Game, This game is also still undergoing plenty of changes.

🌎 Explore all the systems, Build colonies, terraform countless celestial bodies, create ships big enough to span across the galaxy, and earn stacks of cash from multiple methods of gameplay.

80+ star systems, and over 480+ planets and moons.
